title: SAAB CARS USA, INC.: LIGHTING:LAMP OR SOCKET:BRAKE LIGHTS (59 affected)
summary: ONE OF THE BULBS IN EACH OF THE BRAKE LIGHT LOWER OUTBOARD LAMP ASSEMBLIES MAY NOT HAVE BEEN PROPERLY WIRED, RESULTING IN IMPROPER TAIL LIGHT ILLUMINATION ON BRAKE APPLICATION. THIS DOES NOT CONFORM TO THE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO 108, "LAMPS, REFLECTIVE DEVICES, AND ASSOCIATED EQUIPMENT."

title: Isuzu Motors Limited: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:LINES:HOSE:NON-METALLIC (130 affected)
summary: ON SOME VEHICLES, THE SEALING SURFACES FOR A HYDRAULIC BRAKE HOSE ON A FRONT BRAKE CALIPER WERE COVERED BY PAINT RESIDUE. BRAKE FLUID GRADUALLY DISSOLVES THE PAINT, OPENING A SMALL PATH BETWEEN THE SEALING SURFACE AND THE GASKET ALLOWING BRAKE FLUID TO LEAK WHEN THE BRAKE IS APPLIED.

title: Blue Bird Body Company: SUSPENSION:I-BEAM:SOLID:FRONT BEARING:WHEEL (681 affected)
summary: THE WHEELBEARING LOCKNUT AND COTTER PIN WERE NOT INSTALLED ON THE FRONT AXLE HUBS. THE CAN CAUSE A GRADUAL INCREASE IN WHEEL SHIMMY.

title: Porsche Cars North America, Inc.: VISUAL SYSTEMS:WINDSHIELD WIPER:MOTOR (1,178 affected)
summary: THE PLASTIC COWL COVER WAS NOT SEALED TO THE BODY AT THE BASE OF THE WINDSHIELD. WATER CAN LEAK AND REACH THE WINDSHIELD WIPER MOTOR, CAUSING INTERNAL CORROSION AND FAILURE OF THE WIPER MOTOR.

title: Pierce Manufacturing: STEERING:POWER:GEAR BOX (2,563 affected)
summary: THE STEERING GEAR BRACKET USED TO MOUNT THE POWER STEERING GEAR TO THE CHASSIS FRAME CAN CRACK AND FAIL.

title: Explorer Van Company, Inc.: EQUIPMENT:CERTIFICATION LABEL (2,255 affected)
summary: THE MANUFACTURER'S CERTIFICATION LABEL AND/OR THE DRIVER AIR BAG ADVISORY LABEL MAY BE MISSING FROM THE VEHICLES, WHICH DOES NOT CONFORM TO THE REQUIREMENTS OF 49 CFR 567.

title: Blue Bird Body Company: BRAKES:AIR SYSTEMS:LINES:METALLIC (74 affected)
summary: AIR BRAKE SUPPLY LINES ARE REVERSED AT THE BRAKE TREADLE VALVE. THIS CAN CAUSE THE MODULATED SPRING BRAKE FEATURE ON THE REAR AXLE BRAKE TO BE INOPERABLE. IN THE EVENT THE REAR BRAKE SUPPLY RESERVOIR WERE LOST, THIS COULD RESULT IN LOSS OF BRAKES WITHOUT PROPER FUNCTION OF THE MODULATED SPRING BRAKE ACTION OF THE REAR BRAKE AXLE TO STOP THE VEHICLE.

title: Hyundai Motor America: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:ALTERNATOR:REGULATOR:STARTER (600 affected)
summary: IN SOME VEHICLES, THE MANUFACTURER'S PROTECTIVE INTERNAL COATING OF THE ELECTRONIC CRANK ANGLE SENSOR DOES NOT MEET SPECIFICATIONS, WHICH CAN CAUSE AN OPEN CIRCUIT AT HIGH OPERATING TEMPERATURES. THIS CAN CAUSE THE VEHICLE TO STALL.

title: Mazda North American Operations: ENGINE COOLING SYSTEM (12,316 affected)
summary: THE RADIATOR CAP PRESSURE RELIEF VALVE RELEASE PRESSURE IS SET TOO HIGH. THIS CAN CAUSE THE COOLANT TO REACH TEMPERATURES THAT EXCEED THE THERMAL DESIGN LIMITS OF SOME COMPONENTS OF THE COOLANT SYSTEM. SHOULD THIS OCCUR, ENGINE COOLANT CAN LEAK COLLECT ON TOP OF THE ENGINE.

title: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC: EQUIPMENT:SPEED CONTROL (1,822 affected)
summary: THE FACTORY INSTALLED CRUISE CONTROL LINKAGE MAY NOT HAVE BEEN ADEQUATELY LUBRICATED, WHICH CAN CAUSE BINDING AND THE THROTTLE WILL NOT RETURN TO THE CLOSED POSITION WHEN THE ACCELERATOR PEDAL IS RELEASED.

title: THOMAS BUILT BUSES, INC.: EQUIPMENT:OTHER LABELS (423 affected)
summary: A DECAL WARNING OF THE POTENTIAL DANGER IN USING STARTING FLUID TO START THE ENGINE WAS OMITTED.

title: Ohlins Racing AB: STEERING:YOKE (MOTORCYCLE) (491 affected)
summary: THE ONE-WAY VALVE IN THE STEERING DAMPERS IS USED TO CONTROL THE HYDRAULIC OIL FLOW SO THAT THE OIL VOLUME INSIDE THE STEERING DAMPER EXPANDS WITH TEMPERATURE. THE VALVE SEAT CAN BECOME DEFORMED DURING USE, CAUSING UNCONTROLLED RESTRICTION OF THE OIL FLOW. THE DEFORMED VALVE CAUSES THE INTERNAL PRESSURE ON THE DAMPER OILS SEALS TO INCREASE FROM INCREASED OIL TEMPERATURE AND VOLUME EXPANSION.

title: General Motors, LLC: POWER TRAIN:TRANSMISSION:AUTOMATIC (72,664 affected)
summary: SIGNIFICANT WEAR CAN DEVELOP ON THE LOW AND REVERSE CLUTCH PREVENTING THE PARK PAWL FROM ENGAGING. THIS CAN PREVENT A "NO PARK" CONDITION TO OCCUR WHILE THE ENGINE IS RUNNING, CAUSING UNINTENTIONAL MOVEMENT OF THE VEHICLE WITHOUT OPERATOR ACTION. (THE "NO PARK" CONDITION WILL NOT OCCUR WHILE THE ENGINE IS OFF.)

title: KINEDYNE CORPORATION: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:ACTIVE SEAT AND SHOULDER BELTS AN (3,182 affected)
summary: THE KEEPER SPRINGS (FROM THE SNAP HOOKS) CAN BECOME DISENGAGED FROM THE HOOK/KEEPER, ALLOWING INADVERTENT RELEASE OF THE SNAP HOOK.

title: PACCAR Incorporated: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:RESTRAINT:BELT ANCHOR AND ATTACHM (155 affected)
summary: THE ANCHOR END OF THE SAFETY BELT BUCKLE WAS INCORRECTLY LOCATED, CAUSING THE UPPER TORSO RESTRAINT TO BE IMPROPERLY POSITIONED.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): SUSPENSION:INDEPENDENT FRONT (400 affected)
summary: THE FRONT SUSPENSION TRACK BAR HAS INADEQUATE FATIGUE STRENGTH.

title: Cooper Tire & Rubber Co.: TIRES:LINER (574 affected)
summary: SOME TIRES HAVE A LESS THAN ADEQUATE OR THIN INNER LINER THAT CAN RESULT IN A SUDDEN LOSS OF AIR PRESSURE.

title: IC CORPORATION: BRAKES:FLUID:HYDRAULIC (FLUID CONTAMINATION/WRONG (56 affected)
summary: THE BRAKE FLUID INITIALLY INSTALLED BY THE MANUFACTURER IS CONTAMINATED.

title: Winnebago Industries, Inc.: EXHAUST SYSTEM (401 affected)
summary: THE GENERATOR EXHAUST SYSTEM EXTENDS BELOW THE FLOOR WHERE IT CAN BE CONTACTED BY THE ROAD SURFACE UNDER CERTAIN CONDITIONS, CAUSING DAMAGE TO THE EXHAUST SYSTEM AND UNDER FLOOR STORAGE.

title: EAGLE TRAILERS INC: STRUCTURE:TONGUE DOLLY (542 affected)
summary: TWO BRACKETS WHICH HOLD THE AIR RESERVOIR ARE WELDED TO THE SIDEPLATE OF THE NON-STRUCTURAL TAILFRAME OF THE CONVERTOR DOLLY. A FATIGUE CRACK CAN BEGIN IN THE SIDEPLATE AND EVENTUALLY ALLOW THE BRACKET TO BREAK, CAUSING THE AIR RESERVOIR TO BE SUPPORTED BY THE REMAINING BRACKET. THIS BRACKET CAN CRACK AND EVENTUALLY BREAK, LEAVING THE RESERVOIR SUPPORTED BY HOSES AND TUBING.

title: Oshkosh Corporation: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:IGNITION:ELECTRONIC CONTROL UNIT (855 affected)
summary: A CRUISE CONTROL ELECTRONIC REGULATOR (CCER) IS PROVIDED WITH THE TRUCK CHASSIS, AND IS MOUNTED ON THE CHASSIS ACCORDING TO INSTRUCTIONAL DRAWINGS PROVIDED BY OSHKOSH. SOME BODY BUILDERS HAVE INSTALLED THE CCER OUTSIDE THE PASSENGER COMPARTMENT. IN THIS LOCATION, MOISTURE CAN ACCUMULATE AROUND THE CIRCUIT BOARD CAUSING A SIGNAL TO GO TO THE VACUUM PUMP OF THE CRUISE CONTROL, WHICH PULLS THE THROTTLE TO A "FULL OPEN" POSITION WITHOUT WARNING. DEPRESSING THE BRAKE OR TURNING OFF THE CRUISE CONTROL SWITCH WILL INTERRUPT THE SIGNAL.

title: General Motors, LLC: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:SHOULDER BELTS (5,294 affected)
summary: THE SECOND ROW, RIGHT HAND SHOULDER BELT CAN BECOME "PINCHED" BETWEEN THE SEAT AND THE DOOR FRAME PILLAR TRIM. THE SHOULDER BELT MAY NOT RETRACT PROPERLY, WHICH DOES NOT COMPLY WITH THE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO. 208, "OCCUPANT CRASH PROTECTION." THE 1994 VEHICLES HAVE AN OPTIONAL INTEGRAL (BUILT IN) CHILDSEAT INSTALLED NEXT TO THE POWER SLIDING SIDE DOOR. THE 1993 INVOLVED VEHICLES HAVE STANDARD SEATS IN THAT SAME POSITION.

title: Ford Motor Company: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:IGNITION:ELECTRONIC CONTROL UNIT (900 affected)
summary: IN A HEAVILY LOADED VEHICLE, WHILE IN THE CRUISE CONTROL MODE, THE THROTTLE MAY NOT REDUCE IMMEDIATELY WHEN THE LOAD ON THE ENGINE IS DECREASED (SUCH AS WHEN THE VEHICLE CRESTS A HILL.) THIS CAN RESULT IN INCREASED VEHICLE SPEED WITHOUT PRIOR WARNING.

title: Cooper Tire & Rubber Co.: TIRES:LINER (27 affected)
summary: THESE TIRES WERE PRODUCED WITH INCORRECT LOAD AND INFLATION INFORMATION STAMPED ON THE SERIAL SIDE OF THE TIRES. THIS DOES NOT CONFORM TO FMVSS 109, "NEW PNEUMATIC TIRES."

title: Evenflo Company, Inc.: EQUIPMENT:CHILD SEAT: INDEPENDENT (308,271 affected)
summary: THE SEATS ARE EQUIPPED WITH A LATCHING AID, WHICH IS A GRAY OR WHITE PLASTIC SLEEVE LOCATED AT THE BASE OF THE WEBBING AT THE POINT WHERE THE WEBBING IS JOINED TO THE BUCKLE TONGUE. THE LATCHING AID IS TO PROVIDE THE CONSUMER WITH A CONVENIENT STIFFENER FOR THE WEBBING, IN ORDER TO EASE THE INSERTION OF THE BUCKLE TONGUE INTO THE RECEIVING END OF THE BUCKLE. THIS LATCHING AID CAN BECOME TORN OR SPLIT OR CAN SLIP OUT OF POSITION.
